description: Figure 3 is a bar chart that illustrates the difference in average word error rate (WER) from the Whisper large-v3 model after applying a sequence of cumulative automated optimisation steps. The horizontal axis lists the successive optimisation stages, including corrections for spacing errors, date formats, and American spellings, with each subsequent bar representing the incremental improvement achieved by adding that step to the prior ones. The vertical axis represents the change in WER, measured as a percentage point difference, with positive values indicating a reduction in error rate relative to the baseline Whisper large-v3 performance. The bars are stacked vertically to show the cumulative effect, with each bar’s height reflecting the total improvement up to that stage. The chart visually demonstrates that the cumulative application of these post-processing steps progressively closes the performance gap between Whisper large-v3 and the fine-tuned models, as described in the accompanying text. The bars are uniformly colored and increase in height from left to right, indicating that each additional optimisation step contributes to further WER reduction.
